title: VYBE 0.11.0
notes: Release 0.11.0: Constrained square video player with landscape fullscreen & explicit quality selector (4K/1080p/720p/480p/360p), Release Radar 30-day fresh music on Home, instant trending search, enhanced song recognition with cancel & skip, default Downloads tab in library, resilient album loading, and zero-quota Spotify Web Player token authentication.
